```{r Constants}
ALIGNMENT_TYPES <- c("left_flanking", "spanning", "right_flanking")

# Set thresholds for when to use points or tiles in Abacus plot (too many points can be slow to render and interpret)
ABACUS_PLOT_MAX_POINT_READS <- 40
ABACUS_PLOT_MAX_POINT_KMERS <- 50

# Colors
HEADER_BACKGROUND <- "grey87"
STRIPED_BACKGROUND <- "grey97"
ATTENTION_COLOR <- "#FF5733"

HAPLOTYPE_COLORS <- c("#308EFF", "#30CDFF", "#30FF60", "#C030FF", ATTENTION_COLOR)
names(HAPLOTYPE_COLORS) <- c("h1", "h2", "hom", "outlier", "qc_filtered")
```

```{r Functions}
wrangle_reads_data <- function(reads_df) {
  reads_df %>%
    # Get number of kmers
    mutate(
      # Fix missing
      obs_kmer_string = if_else(is.na(obs_kmer_string), "", obs_kmer_string),
      # Count kmers
      n_kmer = str_count(obs_kmer_string, fixed("|")) + 1,
      # Convert alignment_type to factor
      alignment_type_fct = factor(alignment_type, levels = ALIGNMENT_TYPES),
      alignment_type_txt = if_else(
        alignment_type == "spanning", "Spanning", "Flanking"
      ),
      alignment_subtype_txt = case_when(
        alignment_type == "left_flanking" ~ "Left flanking",
        alignment_type == "right_flanking" ~ "Right flanking",
        alignment_type == "spanning" ~ "Spanning"
      )
    ) %>%
    # Arrange reads by haplotype, alignment_type, mapping_start, length and sequence
    arrange(
      haplotype,
      alignment_type_fct,
      if_else(
        alignment_type == "right_flanking",
        dplyr::desc(n_kmer),
        n_kmer
      ),
      obs_kmer_string
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Assign read_id
    mutate(read_id = row_number())
}

# Wrangle STR data for abacus plot
mod_ascii_to_prob <- function(mod_ascii) {
  # Check if mod_ascii is empty
  if (nchar(mod_ascii) == 0) {
    return(0)
  }
  # Convert to numeric
  mod_prob <- mod_ascii %>%
    charToRaw() %>%
    as.numeric()
  # Correct for ASCII values
  mod_prob <- (mod_prob - 33) * 10
  # Remove values outside 0-100
  mod_prob <- mod_prob[mod_prob >= 0 & mod_prob <= 100]
  # Return NA if no values
  if (length(mod_prob) == 0) {
    return(NA)
  }
  # Set mod_prob to max value
  mod_prob <- max(mod_prob)
  return(mod_prob)
}

ascii_to_qual <- function(ascii) {
  # Check if ascii is empty
  if (nchar(ascii) == 0) {
    return(0)
  }
  # Convert to numeric
  ascii_int <- ascii %>%
    charToRaw() %>%
    as.numeric()
  # Correct for ASCII values
  quals <- ascii_int - 33
  # Return mean quality
  qual <- mean(quals, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(qual)
}

wrangle_reads_to_kmers <- function(reads_df) {
  reads_df %>%
    # Get one line per kmer
    mutate(
      kmer = str_split(obs_kmer_string, fixed("|")),
      ref_kmer = str_split(ref_kmer_string, fixed("|")),
      mod_kmer = str_split(mod_5mc_kmer_string, fixed("|")),
      qual_kmer = str_split(qual_kmer_string, fixed("|")),
    ) %>%
    unnest_longer(
      col = c(kmer, ref_kmer, mod_kmer, qual_kmer),
      values_to = "{col}",
      indices_to = "{col}_idx"
    ) %>%
    # Fix NA values
    mutate(
      kmer = if_else(is.na(kmer), "", kmer),
      ref_kmer = if_else(is.na(ref_kmer), "", ref_kmer),
      mod_kmer = if_else(is.na(mod_kmer), "", mod_kmer),
      qual_kmer = if_else(is.na(qual_kmer), "", qual_kmer),
    ) %>%
    # Translated mod kmer to probability from ASCII value (33-43 -> 0,10,20,...,100)
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      mod_prob = mod_ascii_to_prob(mod_kmer),
      qual = ascii_to_qual(qual_kmer)
    )
}

# Make color palette for kmers
generate_kmer_color_palette <- function(kmers) {
  # Set max number of colors
  max_cols <- 12

  # Trim kmers if too many
  if (length(kmers) > max_cols) {
    kmers <- kmers[1:max_cols]
  }

  # Get color palette
  full_paired_palette <- brewer.pal(max_cols, "Paired")
  reordered_palette <- c(full_paired_palette[(1:6) * 2], full_paired_palette[(1:6) * 2 - 1])

  kmer_colors <- reordered_palette[seq_along(kmers)]
  names(kmer_colors) <- kmers

  return(kmer_colors)
}

# Function to create kmer plots
create_kmer_plot <- function(kmer_df, color_by, kmer_color_palette, shade_by_qual = FALSE) {
  kmer_plot_df <- kmer_df %>%
    # Get max per haplotype
    group_by(haplotype) %>%
    mutate(max_kmer_haplotype = max(n_kmer)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Get start and end for flanking reads
    mutate(
      start = case_when(
        alignment_type == "left_flanking" ~ -Inf,
        alignment_type == "right_flanking" ~ max_kmer_haplotype - n_kmer + 1,
        alignment_type == "spanning" ~ -Inf
      ),
      end = case_when(
        alignment_type == "left_flanking" ~ n_kmer,
        alignment_type == "right_flanking" ~ Inf,
        alignment_type == "spanning" ~ Inf
      ),
    ) %>%
    # Correct start and end of flanking reads
    mutate(
      cor_kmer_idx = if_else(
        alignment_type == "right_flanking",
        kmer_idx + start - 1,
        kmer_idx
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Start plotting
  plot <- ggplot()

  # Add horizontal lines for each read
  hz_lines_df <- kmer_plot_df %>%
    distinct(read_id, alignment_type_txt, start, end, haplotype)

  plot <- plot +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = start, xend = end,
        y = read_id, yend = read_id,
        # alpha = alignment_type_txt
      ),
      lwd = 1,
      # Round ends
      lineend = "round",
      data = hz_lines_df
    )
  # scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Spanning" = 1, "Flanking" = 0.4)) +
  # labs(alpha = "Alignment type")

  # Get "dimensionality" of plot
  n_reads <- nrow(hz_lines_df)
  n_kmers <- max(kmer_plot_df$cor_kmer_idx)

  # Add points for each kmer
  if (color_by == "kmer" || color_by == "ref_kmer") {
    # If ref_kmer is selected, use ref_kmer instead of kmer
    if (color_by == "ref_kmer") {
      kmer_plot_df <- kmer_plot_df %>%
        mutate(kmer = ref_kmer)
    }

    # Add "Other" (grey) to color palette in end
    kmer_color_palette["Other"] <- "grey"

    kmer_plot_df <- kmer_plot_df %>%
      mutate(
        # Change non-top kmers to "Other"
        kmer = if_else(kmer %in% names(kmer_color_palette), kmer, "Other"),
        # Convert to factor
        kmer = factor(kmer, levels = names(kmer_color_palette))
      )

    # Add points/tiles and color by kmer
    if (n_reads < ABACUS_PLOT_MAX_POINT_READS && n_kmers < ABACUS_PLOT_MAX_POINT_KMERS) {
      plot <- plot +
        geom_point(
          aes(
            x = cor_kmer_idx,
            y = read_id,
            col = kmer,
            alpha = qual
          ),
          size = 5,
          data = kmer_plot_df
        ) +
        # Add color palette
        scale_color_manual(
          values = kmer_color_palette,
          name = "K-mer\n(ord. by freq.)"
        )
    } else {
      plot <- plot +
        geom_tile(
          aes(
            x = cor_kmer_idx,
            y = read_id,
            fill = kmer,
            alpha = qual
          ),
          data = kmer_plot_df
        ) +
        # Add color palette
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = kmer_color_palette,
          name = "K-mer\n(ord. by freq.)"
        )
    }

    # Handle if alpha is used
    if (shade_by_qual) {
      plot <- plot +
        scale_alpha_continuous(
          limits = c(20, 40),
          name = "Quality"
        )
    } else {
      plot <- plot +
        scale_alpha_continuous(limits = c(-1, -1)) +
        guides(alpha = "none")
    }
  } else if (color_by == "mod") {
    # Add points/tiles and color by mod probability
    if (n_reads < ABACUS_PLOT_MAX_POINT_READS && n_kmers < ABACUS_PLOT_MAX_POINT_KMERS) {
      plot <- plot +
        geom_point(
          aes(x = cor_kmer_idx, y = read_id, col = mod_prob),
          size = 5,
          data = kmer_plot_df
        ) +
        # Add color gradient with low (0) = "blue", high (100) = "red", NA = "grey" (similar to IGV)
        scale_color_gradient(
          low = "blue",
          high = "red",
          na.value = "grey",
          limits = c(0, 100)
        ) +
        labs(color = "5mC (prob.)")
    } else {
      plot <- plot +
        geom_tile(
          aes(x = cor_kmer_idx, y = read_id, fill = mod_prob),
          data = kmer_plot_df
        ) +
        # Add color gradient with low (0) = "blue", high (100) = "red", NA = "grey" (similar to IGV)
        scale_fill_gradient(
          low = "blue",
          high = "red",
          na.value = "grey",
          limits = c(0, 100)
        ) +
        labs(fill = "5mC (prob.)")
    }
  } else {
    # Error
    stop("Invalid color_by argument.")
  }

  # Add details to plot
  min_kmer_idx <- min(kmer_plot_df$cor_kmer_idx)
  vertical_fixer_df <- kmer_plot_df %>%
    distinct(read_id, haplotype) %>%
    group_by(haplotype) %>%
    summarise(
      min_read_idx = min(read_id),
      max_read_idx = max(read_id),
      # Group size
      group_size = n(),
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      # Add space between groups
      min_read_idx = if_else(group_size < 10, min_read_idx - 0.5, min_read_idx),
      max_read_idx = if_else(group_size < 10, max_read_idx + 0.5, max_read_idx),
      x = 0.5
    )

  plot <- plot +
    facet_grid(
      rows = vars(haplotype),
      scales = "free_y",
      space = "free_y"
    ) +
    # Fix y axis with "fake" data, i.e. transparent lines
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = x, xend = x,
        y = min_read_idx, yend = max_read_idx,
      ),
      data = vertical_fixer_df,
      alpha = 0,
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "K-mer index",
      y = "Read ID",
    ) +
    # Breaks for y: Every integer, pretty, start at 1
    scale_y_reverse(breaks = function(x) unique(round(sort(pmax(min_kmer_idx, pretty(x)))))) +
    # Remove "minor" ticks
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  return(plot)
}

add_colors_to_consensus_strings <- function(consensus_strings, kmer_color_palette) {
  consensus_strings_parts <- str_split(consensus_strings, "-")
  colored_consensus_strings <- c()
  for (part in consensus_strings_parts) {
    # Extract counts
    counts <- str_extract(part, "[0-9]+")

    # Extract kmers
    kmers <- str_extract(part, "[A-Z]+")

    # Add color
    colored_consensus_string <- ""
    for (i in seq_along(counts)) {
      count <- counts[i]
      kmer <- kmers[i]

      # Add color and make bold
      if (kmer %in% names(kmer_color_palette)) {
        colored_kmer <- paste0("<span style='color:", kmer_color_palette[kmer], "; font-weight: bold;'>", kmer, "</span>")
      } else {
        colored_kmer <- kmer
      }

      # Add to colored string
      colored_consensus_string <- paste0(colored_consensus_string, "-", count, "(", colored_kmer, ")")
    }

    # Remove first "-"
    colored_consensus_string <- substr(colored_consensus_string, 2, nchar(colored_consensus_string))

    # Add to list
    colored_consensus_strings <- c(colored_consensus_strings, colored_consensus_string)
  }
  return(colored_consensus_strings)
}

generate_length_plot <- function(counts_df, density_df, satellite) {
  NBINS <- min(100, max(counts_df$count, 1))
  BIN_SZ <- ceiling(max(counts_df$count, 1) / NBINS)

  counts_df <- counts_df %>%
    mutate(
      count = count %/% BIN_SZ * BIN_SZ
    ) %>%
    group_by(haplotype, alignment_type_txt, count) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

  length_plot <- ggplot(counts_df) +
    # Add histogram of STR length
    geom_col(
      aes(
        x = count,
        y = n,
        fill = haplotype,
        alpha = alignment_type_txt
      ),
      width = BIN_SZ
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(round(sort(pretty(x))))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(round(sort(pretty(x))))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = HAPLOTYPE_COLORS) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Spanning" = 1.0, "Flanking" = 0.6))

  # Add distributions
  if (nrow(density_df) > 0) {
    haplotype_linetype <- c("hom" = "dashed", "h1" = "solid", "h2" = "dotted")

    max_n <- counts_df %>%
      group_by(count) %>%
      summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
      pull(n) %>%
      max()
    density_df <- density_df %>%
      group_by(haplotype) %>%
      mutate(d = d / max(d) * !!max_n) %>%
      ungroup()

    length_plot <- length_plot +
      geom_line(
        data = density_df,
        aes(x = x, y = d, linetype = haplotype),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.75
      ) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = haplotype_linetype)
  }

  # Add title, labels and legend
  length_plot <- length_plot +
    # Add title and labels
    labs(
      title = paste("Satellite:", satellite),
      x = "STR length",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    # Name the legend
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(title = "Haplotype"),
      alpha = guide_legend(title = "Alignment type"),
      linetype = guide_legend(title = "Haplotype")
    )

  return(length_plot)
}
```

```{r Sample information table, results = TRUE}
# Create table
data.frame(
  abacus_version = abacus_version,
  sample_id = sample_id,
  date = format(Sys.time(), "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M"),
  bam = basename(input_bam),
  json = basename(str_catalog)
) %>%
  select(
    "Abacus version" = abacus_version,
    "Sample ID" = sample_id,
    "Date" = date,
    "BAM file" = bam,
    "STR catalog" = json
  ) %>%
  # Transpose
  t() %>%
  kbl(align = "l") %>%
  kable_styling("bordered", full_width = TRUE) %>%
  # Make first column grey
  column_spec(1, background = HEADER_BACKGROUND, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r Wrangle data}
test_df <- test_summary_df %>%
  select(locus_id, is_significant, backup_test_run, backup_test_significant)

signif_par_summary_df <- all_final_par_summary_df %>%
  # Filter on significant estimates
  left_join(test_df, by = join_by(locus_id)) %>%
  mutate(backup_split = backup_test_run & !backup_test_significant) %>%
  filter(
    (is_significant  & haplotype != "hom") |         # primary het test detected split
    (backup_split    & haplotype != "hom") |         # equal-length sequence split detected
    (!is_significant & !backup_split & haplotype == "hom")  # homozygous
  ) %>%
  # Arrange by satellite and haplotype
  arrange(locus_id, idx, haplotype)

is_ci_row_wide_vec <- signif_par_summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_ci_wide = mean_upper - mean_lower > 2,
    # Fix NA
    is_ci_wide = if_else(is.na(is_ci_wide), FALSE, is_ci_wide)
  ) %>%
  pull(is_ci_wide)

# Outlier counts per locus (for summary table)
outlier_counts_df <- reads_df %>%
  filter(haplotype == "outlier") %>%
  group_by(locus_id) %>%
  summarise(outlier_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Build summary table (one row per locus x satellite x haplotype)
summary_table_df <- signif_par_summary_df %>%
  left_join(
    clustering_summary_df %>% select(locus_id, satellite, haplotype, n),
    by = join_by(locus_id, satellite, haplotype)
  ) %>%
  left_join(outlier_counts_df, by = join_by(locus_id)) %>%
  mutate(outlier_count = if_else(is.na(outlier_count), 0L, as.integer(outlier_count))) %>%
  arrange(locus_id, idx, haplotype) %>%
  select(locus_id, outlier_count, satellite, haplotype, n, mean, mean_lower, mean_upper)
```

## Summary

Count estimates and 95% confidence intervals for all analysed loci. Click a Locus ID to jump to the corresponding section in the report. 

```{r Summary section, results = TRUE}
# Row indices for even-numbered loci (zebra stripe at locus level)
summary_stripe_rows <- summary_table_df %>%
  mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(locus_id) %>%
  mutate(locus_rank = cur_group_id()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(locus_rank %% 2 == 0) %>%
  pull(row_num)

summary_table_df %>%
  mutate(
    locus_link = paste0(
      '<a href="#', tolower(gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]+", "-", locus_id)), '">',
      locus_id, '</a>'
    ),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2))
  ) %>%
  select(
    "Locus ID"       = locus_link,
    "Outlier count"  = outlier_count,
    "Satellite"      = satellite,
    "Haplotype"      = haplotype,
    "Coverage"       = n,
    "Count estimate" = mean,
    "CI lower"       = mean_lower,
    "CI upper"       = mean_upper
  ) %>%
  kbl(align = "c", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling("bordered", full_width = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = HEADER_BACKGROUND) %>%
  row_spec(summary_stripe_rows, background = STRIPED_BACKGROUND) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = c(1, 2, 3), valign = "middle", target = 1)
```

```{r Build report, results = "asis"}
# Get distinct regions (for looping)
regions <- reads_df %>%
  distinct(locus_id, locus_chrom, locus_start, locus_end, satellites_str, structure) %>%
  arrange(locus_id)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(regions))) {
  selected_region <- regions[i, ]

  # Filter data to selected region
  reads_region_df <- reads_df %>%
    semi_join(selected_region, by = join_by(locus_id)) %>%
    wrangle_reads_data()

  if (nrow(filtered_reads_df) > 0) {
    filtered_reads_region_df <- filtered_reads_df %>%
      semi_join(selected_region, by = join_by(locus_id))
  } else {
    filtered_reads_region_df <- data.frame()
  }

  test_summary_region_df <- test_summary_df %>%
    semi_join(selected_region, by = join_by(locus_id))

  test_par_summary_region_df <- all_test_par_summary_df %>%
    semi_join(selected_region, by = join_by(locus_id))

  final_par_summary_region_df <- all_final_par_summary_df %>%
    semi_join(selected_region, by = join_by(locus_id))

  signif_par_summary_region_df <- signif_par_summary_df %>%
    semi_join(selected_region, by = join_by(locus_id))

  clustering_summary_region_df <- clustering_summary_df %>%
    semi_join(selected_region, by = join_by(locus_id))

  # Calculate coverage
  n_haplotyped_reads <- nrow(reads_region_df %>% filter(!haplotype %in% c("outlier", "qc_filtered")))
  n_qc_filtered_reads <- nrow(reads_region_df %>% filter(haplotype == "qc_filtered"))
  n_filtered_reads <- nrow(filtered_reads_region_df)

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("##", selected_region$locus_id)
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### Locus information")
  cat("\n\n")

  selected_region %>%
    mutate(
      goto_link = paste0("http://localhost:60151/goto?locus=", locus_chrom, ":", locus_start, "-", locus_end),
      igv_link = paste0("[Go to locus](", goto_link, ")"),
      structure = str_replace_all(structure, fixed("*"), fixed("\\*"))
    ) %>%
    select(
      "Locus ID" = locus_id,
      "Chrom" = locus_chrom,
      "Start" = locus_start,
      "End" = locus_end,
      "Structure" = structure,
      "IGV link" = igv_link
    ) %>%
    kbl(
      align = "c"
    ) %>%
    kable_styling("bordered", full_width = TRUE) %>%
    row_spec(
      0,
      background = HEADER_BACKGROUND
    ) %>%
    cat()

  # Abacus plot
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### Abacus plot {.tabset .tabset-pills}")
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("A visual representation illustrating the distribution of individual $k$-mers as colored *beads* along a linear sequence, with each horizontal sequence representing individual reads. The reads are grouped into haplotypes called by an unsupervised clustering algorithm (EM). Additionally, a separate group is designated for outlier reads. A read can be classified as an outlier either based on an unusual $k$-mer count or nucleotide sequence. There are 3 versions of the plot where the beads are colored by the observed $k$-mer, the reference $k$-mer, and the methylation probability of the $k$-mer. Spanning and flanking reads are shown as black and grey lines, respectively.")
  cat("\n\n")

  kmer_df <- wrangle_reads_to_kmers(reads_region_df)

  # Split data
  kmer_haplotyped_df <- kmer_df %>%
    filter(haplotype != "qc_filtered")

  kmer_qc_filtered_df <- kmer_df %>%
    filter(haplotype == "qc_filtered")

  no_haplotype_reads <- nrow(kmer_haplotyped_df) == 0
  no_qc_filtered_reads <- nrow(kmer_qc_filtered_df) == 0

  # Get color palette
  # Get kmers that should be prioritized for color
  # Ref kmers
  ref_kmers <- kmer_haplotyped_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(ref_kmer)) %>%
    count(ref_kmer) %>%
    arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
    pull(ref_kmer)

  # Most observed kmers
  top_obs_kmers <-
    kmer_haplotyped_df %>%
    # Remove qc_filtered reads, NA and empty kmers
    filter(haplotype != "qc_filtered", !is.na(kmer), kmer != "") %>%
    # Remove kmers that are in ref_kmers
    filter(!kmer %in% ref_kmers) %>%
    # Count kmers occurrences
    group_by(kmer) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      n_unique_read = n_distinct(read_id),
    ) %>%
    # Get top kmers
    arrange(dplyr::desc(n_unique_read), dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
    pull(kmer)

  # Select kmers for color palette
  n_colors <- 12
  top_kmers <- c(ref_kmers, top_obs_kmers) %>%
    unique() %>%
    head(n_colors)

  kmer_color_palette <- generate_kmer_color_palette(top_kmers)

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("#### Sequence")
  cat("\n\n")

  if (no_haplotype_reads) {
    cat("There are no haplotyped reads for this locus.")
  } else {
    kmer_plot <- create_kmer_plot(kmer_haplotyped_df, "kmer", kmer_color_palette)
    print(kmer_plot)
  }

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("#### Sequence w. QUAL")
  cat("\n\n")

  if (no_haplotype_reads) {
    cat("There are no haplotyped reads for this locus.")
  } else {
    kmer_plot <- create_kmer_plot(kmer_haplotyped_df, "kmer", kmer_color_palette, shade_by_qual = TRUE)
    print(kmer_plot)
  }

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("#### Reference")
  cat("\n\n")

  if (no_haplotype_reads) {
    cat("There are no haplotyped reads for this locus.")
  } else {
    kmer_plot <- create_kmer_plot(kmer_haplotyped_df, "ref_kmer", kmer_color_palette)
    print(kmer_plot)
  }

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("#### Methylation (5mC)")
  cat("\n\n")

  if (no_haplotype_reads) {

  } else if (all(is.na(kmer_haplotyped_df$mod_prob))) {
    cat("There is no methylation information for this locus.")
  } else {

    print(kmer_plot)
  }

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("#### QC Filtered (N=", n_qc_filtered_reads, ")", sep = "")
  cat("\n\n")

  if (no_qc_filtered_reads) {
    cat("There are no QC filtered reads for this locus.")
  } else {
    # QC filtered color palette
    top_qc_filtered_kmers <- kmer_qc_filtered_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(kmer)) %>%
      # Remove long non-reference kmers
      filter(nchar(kmer) < 25 | kmer %in% ref_kmers) %>%
      count(kmer) %>%
      arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
      pull(kmer) %>%
      head(n_colors)

    # Generate color palette
    qc_filtered_color_palette <- generate_kmer_color_palette(top_qc_filtered_kmers)
    new_qc_filtered_color_palette <- c()

    # Find overlapping and new kmers compared to kmer_color_palette
    overlapping_kmers <- intersect(names(qc_filtered_color_palette), names(kmer_color_palette))
    new_kmers <- setdiff(names(qc_filtered_color_palette), overlapping_kmers)

    # Re-use color palette from top_kmers
    new_qc_filtered_color_palette[overlapping_kmers] <- kmer_color_palette[overlapping_kmers]

    # Add unused colors to new kmers
    unused_colors <- setdiff(qc_filtered_color_palette, new_qc_filtered_color_palette)
    new_qc_filtered_color_palette[new_kmers] <- unused_colors

    kmer_plot <- create_kmer_plot(kmer_qc_filtered_df, "kmer", new_qc_filtered_color_palette)
    print(kmer_plot)
  }

  # Add Coverage and group summaries
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### {-}") # This is a placeholder to stop the tabset

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### Count estimates")
  cat("\n\n")

  signif_par_summary_region_df %>%
    # Round to 2 decimals
    mutate_if(is.numeric, ~ round(., 2)) %>%
    # Select parameters, round and print
    select(
      "Locus ID" = locus_id,
      "Satellite" = satellite,
      "Haplotype" = haplotype,
      "Count estimate" = mean,
      "95% CI Lower" = mean_lower,
      "95% CI Upper" = mean_upper,
    ) %>%

    ) %>%

    row_spec(
      0,

    ) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = c(1, 2), valign = "middle", target = 1) %>%
    cat()

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### Group summaries")
  cat("\n\n")

  clustering_summary_region_df %>%
    # Arrange by satellite and haplotype
    arrange(idx, haplotype) %>%
    # Select parameters, round and print
    select(
      "Satellite" = satellite,

  cat("\n\n")

  cat("#### QC plot")
  cat("\n\n")

  qc_thresholds_df <- tibble(

  cat("\n\n")

        "STR Error Rate" = str_error_rate,

      ) %>%

      ) %>%

  } else {
    cat("There is no consensus sequence for this locus. \n")

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### Histogram plots {.tabset .tabset-pills}")
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("A histogram showing the number of occurrences of the individual $k$-mers. If more than one $k$-mer is present in the pattern one histogram is shown for each $k$-mer. Bars are coloured by haplotype; outlier reads are included and shown in purple. QC filtered reads are not shown in the grouped plot.")

  if (no_haplotype_reads) {
    cat("There are no haplotyped reads for this locus.")
  } else {
    # Plot count


    # Get parameters
    final_par <- final_par_summary_region_df %>%
      filter(haplotype %in% c("h1", "h2", "hom")) %>%
      # Calculate sd
      mutate(
        sd = sqrt(unit_var * mean),
        satellite_idx = idx + 1
      )

    # Create density data
    density_df <-
      final_par %>%
      # Remove NA values
      filter(!is.na(mean)) %>%
      # Get x values for density plot, from mean - 5*sd to mean + 5*sd with 101 points
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        plot_sd = pmax(sd, 0.2),
        x = list(seq(mean - 5 * plot_sd, mean + 5 * plot_sd, length.out = 101)),
      ) %>%
      unnest(x) %>%
      group_by(haplotype) %>%
      mutate(
        d = dnorm(x, mean = mean, sd = plot_sd)
      )

    # Get length data
    length_df <- reads_region_df %>%
      mutate(
        count = str_split(kmer_count_str, "-")
      ) %>%
      unnest_longer(col = count, indices_to = "satellite_idx") %>%
      mutate(
        count = as.integer(count),
        alignment_type_txt = if_else(
          alignment_type == "spanning", "Spanning", "Flanking"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(
        haplotype, alignment_type_txt, satellite_idx, count
      )

    # Get satellites
    satellites <- str_split(selected_region$satellites_str, "-", simplify = TRUE)

    # Create plots for each satellite
    for (j in seq_along(satellites)) {
      # Get satellite
      satellite <- satellites[j]

      cat("\n\n")
      cat("#### Satellite", j, "{.tabset .tabset-pills}")
      cat("\n\n")

      # Filter data
      counts_index_df <- length_df %>%
        filter(
          satellite_idx == !!j
        ) %>%
        count(
          haplotype, alignment_type_txt, count
        )

      density_index_df <-
        density_df %>%
        filter(satellite_idx == !!j)

      cat("\n\n")
      cat("##### Grouped")
      cat("\n\n")

      length_plot_df <- counts_index_df %>%
        filter(haplotype != "qc_filtered")

      if (nrow(length_plot_df) > 0) {
        length_plot <- generate_length_plot(length_plot_df, density_index_df, satellite)

        cat("\n\n")
        print(length_plot)
        cat("\n\n")
      } else {
        cat("\n\n")
        cat("There are no grouped reads for this locus.")
        cat("\n\n")
      }

      cat("\n\n")
      cat("##### QC Filtered")
      cat("\n\n")

      length_plot_df <- counts_index_df %>%
        filter(haplotype == "qc_filtered")

      if (nrow(length_plot_df) > 0) {
        length_plot <- generate_length_plot(length_plot_df, data.frame(), satellite)
        cat("\n\n")
        print(length_plot)
        cat("\n\n")
      } else {
        cat("\n\n")
        cat("There are no QC filtered reads for this locus.")
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### Heterozygosity test summary")
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("#### Length-based heterozygosity test")
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("This table shows the result from a statistical test for heterozygosity. The alternative hypothesis ($H_A$) is that the sample is heterozygous, i.e. that the data comes from two discrete normal distributions, and the null hypothesis ($H_0$) is that the sample is homozygous, i.e. that the data can be grouped into one Gaussian cluster. The test performed is a log-likelihood ratio test where the statistic is assumed to be $\\chi^2$-distributed with degrees of freedom equal to the difference in free parameters under the two hypotheses. The maximized log-likelihoods, number of free parameters, test statistic, degrees of freedom, $p$-value, and conclusion are shown in the following table.")

  test_summary_region_df %>%
    mutate(
      conclusion = if_else(
        is_significant,
        "Heterozygote",
        "Homozygote"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      "Log-likelihood Hetero" = log_lik_hetero,
      "Log-likelihood Hom" = log_lik_hom,
      "# Parameters Hetero" = n_par_hetero,
      "# Parameters Hom" = n_par_hom,
      "$\\chi^2$ Statistic" = statistic,
      "P-value" = p_value,
      "Significant" = is_significant,
      "Conclusion" = conclusion
    ) %>%
    kbl(
      align = "c"
    ) %>%
    kable_styling("bordered", full_width = TRUE) %>%
    row_spec(
      0,
      background = HEADER_BACKGROUND
    ) %>%
    cat()

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("##### Maximum likelihood estimates")
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("###### Mean")
  cat("\n\n")

  test_par_summary_region_df %>%
    mutate(
      model = if_else(haplotype == "hom", "Homozygote", "Heterozygote")
    ) %>%
    arrange(model, haplotype, idx) %>%
    select(
      "Model" = model,
      "Satellite" = satellite,
      "Haplotype" = haplotype,
      "Mean" = mean,
    ) %>%
    mutate_if(is.numeric, ~ round(., 2)) %>%
    kbl(align = "c") %>%
    kable_styling("bordered", full_width = TRUE) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, valign = "middle", target = 1) %>%
    row_spec(
      0,
      background = HEADER_BACKGROUND
    ) %>%
    cat()


  cat("\n\n")
  cat("###### Variance")
  cat("\n\n")

  test_par_summary_region_df %>%
    mutate(
      model = if_else(haplotype == "hom", "Homozygote", "Heterozygote")
    ) %>%
    arrange(model, haplotype, idx) %>%
    select(
      "Model" = model,
      "Satellite" = satellite,
      "Unit variance" = unit_var
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate_if(is.numeric, ~ round(., 2)) %>%
    kbl(align = "c") %>%
    kable_styling("bordered", full_width = TRUE) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "middle") %>%
    row_spec(
      0,
      background = HEADER_BACKGROUND
    ) %>%
    cat()

  # Equal-length sequence split test section
  if (isTRUE(test_summary_region_df$backup_test_run[1])) {
    cat("\n\n")
    cat("#### Sequence-based heterozygosity test")
    cat("\n\n")

    cat("When the length-based heterozygosity test is not significant, a sequence-based backup test is performed. The most variable position in the multiple sequence alignment is identified, and a binomial test ($H_0: p = 0.5$) is applied to the counts of the two most common kmers at that position. A **non-significant** result ($p \\geq \\alpha$) means the observed split is consistent with a 50/50 ratio, indicating two alleles with the same length but different sequences — reads are then re-tagged H1/H2. A significant result ($p < \\alpha$) means the ratio deviates from 50/50 and no split is made.")
    cat("\n\n")

    backup_row <- test_summary_region_df %>%
      select(
        "Kmer H1" = backup_test_kmer_h1,
        "Kmer H2" = backup_test_kmer_h2,
        "Position (kmer range)" = backup_test_position_min,
        "Position max" = backup_test_position_max,
        "Count H1" = backup_test_n_h1,
        "Count H2" = backup_test_n_h2,
        "P-value" = backup_test_p_value,
        "Significant" = backup_test_significant
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        `Position (kmer range)` = paste0(`Position (kmer range)`, "\u2013", `Position max`),
        `P-value` = signif(`P-value`, 3),
        Conclusion = if_else(
          Significant,
          "No sequence split detected",
          "Equal-length heterozygote"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(-`Position max`)

    backup_row %>%
      kbl(align = "c") %>%
      kable_styling("bordered", full_width = TRUE) %>%
      row_spec(0, background = HEADER_BACKGROUND) %>%
      cat()

    if (!isTRUE(test_summary_region_df$backup_test_significant[1])) {
      cat("\n\n")
      cat("**Note:** The test was not significant (p \u2265 \u03b1), indicating a 50/50 split. Reads have been re-tagged as H1/H2 based on this test. All other sections of this report reflect the updated haplotype assignments.")
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```
